newsitem.title: USA: NYMEX sets weekly overnight ACCESS volume record.
newsitem.headline: NYMEX sets weekly overnight ACCESS volume record.

text.p: The New York Mercantile Exchange (NYMEX) said total futures and options volume this week on its ACCESS electronic trading system set a weekly record when 41,096 contracts were traded.
The new benchmark tops the previous record of 40,746 contracts that traded the week ending January 12, 1996.
A session record was also set Wednesday night when 14,885 futures and options contracts were traded, surpassing the record of 13,825 traded during the August 23, 1995, session.

Natural gas futures also set an electronic trading record Wednesday night, with 11,041 contracts traded versus the previous all-time ACCESS high for any single commodity set by crude oil futures on April 5, 1994, at 9,479 contracts.
The previous natural gas electronic trading record was 7,556 contracts set during the December 20, 1995, session.
